'''"Old Man" Hamedaw''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Author'sCut" />

He was the [[Janitor/Legends|janitor]] of a [[Unidentified residential building (Coruscant)|residential building]], and was remembered by his neighbor [[Kinalos]] as being cantankerous and committed to his work. During the [[Imperial Civil War]] that followed in the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Coruscant]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], Hamedaw's building was occupied by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial Stormtroopers]] and largely ruined. Many of the residents fled, though Kinalos, returning to the building with the [[New Republic Army]], believed that Hamedaw would have died rather than leave his home.<ref name="Author'sCut" />
